attention_mask: present.max(axis=1) > 0.5 over RESAMPLED presence; fed to every member
measurement_method: host CPU (Apple Silicon, macOS); Python 3.11; ai_edge_litert interpreter

metric_definitions.top1: argmax of softmax over mean raw logits across ensemble members
metric_definitions.top5: true gloss present in the top five classes by that softmax
metric_definitions.coverage: fraction of captures whose top1/top2 margin passes the app gate
metric_definitions.accepted_accuracy: top1 accuracy restricted to captures the gate accepted

note: 184 evaluations is NOT 184 independent signs: 72 unique clips, some repeated with synthetic leading/trailing idle. Report unique clips, never 184.
